description_en: Queries the details of an insurance refund
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen insure-refund-detail --ins-order-id 1000003000000490 --apply-id 1423052318072952023 --out-apply-id 1021000196440356908 --btrip-user-id 1000000001 --buyer-name '张三' --supplier-code fliggy --isv-name PostalSavingsBank --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InsureRefundDetail

parameters.help_en: The insurance order ID. At least one of the following parameters is required: insurance order ID, external refund application ID, or refund application number
parameters.help_zh: 保险订单号，保险订单号和外部退保申请id 和 退保申请单号 必须有一个必填
parameters.name: ins_order_id

parameters.help_en: The refund application number. At least one of the following parameters is required: insurance order ID, external refund application ID, or refund application number
parameters.help_zh: 退保申请单号，保险订单号和外部退保申请id 和 退保申请单号 必须有一个必填
parameters.name: apply_id

parameters.help_en: The external refund application ID. At least one of the following parameters is required: insurance order ID, external refund application ID, or refund application number
parameters.help_zh: 外部退保申请id，保险订单号和外部退保申请id 和 退保申请单号 必须有一个必填
parameters.name: out_apply_id

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise Access Credential" operation (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
